Sure! The minimum arrival time for a package depends on a few factors such as the shipping service you chose (standard, express, etc.), the origin and destination locations, and any special handling requirements.

If you have a tracking ID handy, I can look up the exact status and estimated delivery time for you. Otherwise, here’s a quick overview:

| Service Type | Typical Minimum Arrival Time |
|--------------|------------------------------|
| **Standard** | 2–5 business days (depending on distance) |
| **Express** | 1–2 business days (or same‑day delivery in some areas) |
| **Same‑Day** | Delivery within a few hours (if available in your region) |

If you’d like a precise estimate for your shipment, just share the tracking number or let me know the pickup and delivery cities, and I’ll fetch the latest details for you.
